newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia may issue mark Eurobond in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Russia may issue mark Eurobond in 1997.

text.p: The Russian Finance Ministry is considering Eurobond issues in 1997, including a possible mark-denominated bond, a ministry official said on Wednesday.
"We are currently working on the strategy for Eurobond issues and plan to publish it before the end of the year," deputy head of the foreign credits department Vladimir Dmitriyev told Reuters.
He said the government had not yet decided who would lead manage the next bond.
Russia chose J.P. Morgan and SBS Warburg as lead managers for its debut Eurbond issue last month.
"If their work continues to satisfy us, they may count on being chosen again, but international practice shows there are almost no repetitions," Dmitriyev said.
Russia raised $1 billion with a heavily oversubscribed five-year bond in November. Officials have said they were encouraged by the success and planned to issue more Eurobonds next year.
